Title: Regarding the New Rules Team's Rulings

Messages.Author: David Wilson
Messages.Body:
> Q: If I change my Thrown Sewer Lid (or Wind Dance, etc.) strike with
Primal
> Instincts, do I still get the optional press (or additional strike, etc.)
> from the canceled strike?
> A: No. Canceling a strike made with a strike card cancels the whole effect
> of the card (although it cannot rewind time and cancel any maneuver
already
> used from that strike card - but note that in the case of canceling a
> strike card that had been used to maneuver, the minion cannot choose
> another strike, since the maneuver restricts him to using only that
strike).

Question 1: If Vamp A used the maneuver with the thrown gate and then
primal instincts to cancel the strike then use another copy of thrown gate
as his strike? or does "only that strike" refer to the card? Same
question? 2: applied to some one with two .44 magnums, can they use the
maneuver on one, then after a canine horde wacks the gun, play PI and use
the second .44?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
David Wilson wrote:
> Question 1: If Vamp A used the maneuver with the thrown gate and then
> primal instincts to cancel the strike then use another copy of thrown gate
> as his strike? or does "only that strike" refer to the card? Same
> question? 2: applied to some one with two .44 magnums, can they use the
> maneuver on one, then after a canine horde wacks the gun, play PI and use
> the second .44?

No and no. Maneuvering with a strike or a weapon commits you to striking
with that strike or weapon.
